state.project: GTC: Eatonton Primary - Lick Creek 115kV Line Switch Replacement
state.description: Replace a 1200A RLB line switch on the Eatonton - Lake Oconee 115kV line with a with motor operator and SCADA controls. This switch is located on GTC's Eatonton Primary - Lick Creek 115kV section of the Eatonton Primary - Lake Oconee 115kV Line.

q.instructions: Is this town a fair approximate location for the endpoint?

criteria.true: The endpoint is named after this town (e.g. 'Bluffton' substation near Bluffton, SC).
criteria.false: The name only shares a word with the town or clearly refers to something elsewhere (e.g. 'Union Pier' is not Union, SC).
